title: [Kimi-K3] Fix "wrong grids" crash in DP-sharded vision preprocessing
body:
## Motivation

Regression introduced by #34404

On Kimi-K3 with cpu transport and DP-sharded vision, one batch with ≥2 images of different resolutions crashes the server with `ValueError: Kimi-K3 deferred GPU preprocessing produced wrong grids`.

Root cause: the deferred path reads `grid_thws_host` with shard-local positions instead of global image positions.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/models/kimi_k3.py`: index `grid_thws_host` by global image position at both deferred reads, mapping shard-local positions back via `image_indices`.
- `test/registered/unit/models/test_kimi_k3_vision.py`: `test_kimi_k3_preprocesses_only_dp_owner_images` now uses distinct per-image grids (identical ones mask the bug); fails on main, passes with this fix.

## Accuracy Tests

Verified on 4-node × 8 H100 (TP32/EP32, cpu transport): one request with three different-resolution images crashes on main, completes with this fix.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No impact
